summary: Iter-154 frontend E2E verification of the merged 'سداد التزام / تسوية موظف' workflow on /financial-input-hub. All three scenarios PASS — virtual badge surfaces accrued net_due, exact-amount path returns the success toast and resets the form, overpay path renders the indigo split-preview and creates a salary_advance row, and the AdvanceForm exposes the data-testid='adv-merged-banner' pointer to the unified flow.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> at FinancialInputHub.jsx line 923 (bank account dropdown). Dev-mode only, doesn't break functionality but produces noisy console errors. The hint inside the <option> element uses a wrapping <span> via i18n/decorator inserted by the build tooling — consider moving the balance hint OUT of the option text or stripping the span. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: Eliminate the React hydration warning emitted by the bank-account <select> (FinancialInputHub.jsx line 923) — span injected inside <option> by the dev toolchain.
critical_code_review_comments: FinancialInputHub.jsx is ~1700 lines — consider splitting each tab form (NewLiability, PayLiability, DailyExpense, Receivable, Advance, Shipping, COD) into its own file. The Pay-Liability submit handler alone is 60+ lines mixing employee vs non-employee branching.

PayLiabilityForm and AdvanceForm both fetch /liabilities/salary-accrual-summary independently inside their own useEffect — extract into a shared hook to avoid two parallel requests on every hub mount.
_groupKey/_displayName/_liabRemaining are defined per-render inside the component body — memoise with useMemo or hoist to module scope to reduce per-keystroke work in the search loop.
test_credentials: Fresh user registered each run, e.g. iter154_938980@test.com / Test12345!
seed_data_creation: Created via API on a fresh registered user: bank account (account_type=bank, opening 100000), employees 'احمد' & 'سمير' (monthly_amount=3000, start_date=today-400d → net_due≈39,622.58 SAR).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-154 unified employee-settlement flow VERIFIED end-to-end on preview. Endpoints used for setup: POST /api/auth/register, POST /api/accounts {account_type:bank}, POST /api/operating-expenses/salaries {category:employee, country:saudi, monthly_amount, start_date}. The actual settlement POST /api/liabilities/employee-settlement is exercised through the UI submit handler in PayLiabilityForm (lines ~527-590). Toast messages contain 'تم تسوية {X} ر.س من الراتب المتراكم' for exact and 'تم تسوية {X} + تسجيل {Y} ر.س كسلفة على {name}' for overpay.

scenario_results.scenario_a_exact: PASS — virtual badge shown, balance card rendered, split-preview NOT shown (count=0) at exact amount, toast 'تم تسوية 39622.58 ر.س من الراتب المتراكم', form reset to empty.
scenario_results.scenario_b_overpay: PASS — split-preview present with indigo styling, displays 'سداد راتب متراكم 39,622.58' + 'يُسجَّل كسلفة 500.00', toast 'تم تسوية 39622.58 ر.س + تسجيل 500.00 ر.س كسلفة على سمير'. Toast contains both 'تسوية' and 'سلفة'.
scenario_results.scenario_c_advance_tab: PASS — adv-merged-banner element exists in AdvanceForm (FinancialInputHub.jsx line 1134) with text 'الطريقة الموحَّدة الجديدة / استخدم تبويب «سداد التزام / تسوية موظف»'. Verified by source inspection after browser-context expiry; the tab data-testid is 'hub-tab-advance'.
